build_dag.name: dynamic objective and custody root
deliverables: strict canonical pointer validator and semantic literal audit
exact coupled sublevel and finite-transition admission tool
build_dag.gate: no stale public snapshot laundering, no fabricated authority-shaped JSON, no pre-run-only hashes, and no arbitrary component gate

build_dag.name: C0B-BJ1 semantic baseline join
build_dag.deliverable: compare the exact W_seg semantic program to the reconstructed full C1 baseline at every one of 117,964,800 cells, with seeded-event and non-event residuals
build_dag.gate: live M2 target is regenerated from custodied raw using the frozen batch-exact scorer; cached-label discrepancies remain diagnostic and no target table enters a payload
build_dag.decision: W_seg is not the C1 baseline: 59,814,423 of 117,964,800 cells differ and 10,887 of 17,926 S2 sites do not carry the baseline class expected by W_seg. Preserve W_seg only as a separately identified control/predictor; never compose the C1-referenced S2 packet onto it

build_dag.name: C0B-RB1 identity-bound predictor and syndrome rebase
build_dag.deliverable: define one canonical decoded semantic predictor P with an exact semantic-stream hash, compile V9 factors against the live target, and recompute E=target-minus-P so every residual header binds predictor_state_sha256 and predictor_semantic_sha256
build_dag.gate: decode(P)+decode(E) recovers the intended target cells exactly; swapping any predictor or residual is refused by hash; the old C1 S2 remains teacher/checksum evidence only unless P is exactly C1; no target-table restatement

build_dag.name: C0B-IR1 arbitrary-target inverse realization
build_dag.deliverable: realize V9 obligations through factor-two Y1 and factor-ten native-frame uint8 constraints using target-versus-runner gradients, safe-margin cells, ERF collateral accounting, and palette/gauge reconciliation
build_dag.gate: same decoded receiver bytes satisfy the selected Seg cells; structural XOR/digest/cyclic V10 placeholders are forbidden production physics

build_dag.name: Y0 conditional Pose and feature-relay solve
build_dag.deliverable: solve the frame-zero plane conditional on realized Y1 using xi-advection, amplitude/frequency/phase/contrast controls, Pose VJP/rank-six projections, multiple shooting, and a frozen hard oracle
build_dag.gate: receiver-closed official six-output Pose debt improves without hidden Seg or byte transfer; additive low-rank failure kills only that formulation

build_dag.name: C0B archive sibling and real coder
build_dag.deliverable: compile one original state into a deterministic legal archive and inflate path with real entropy syntax, canonical parse-back, double decode, native 1200-frame raw hash, and state-to-archive/decode receipts
build_dag.gate: all payload/provenance bytes are loaded and hashed from exact snapshots; receiver bytes are consumed; no scorer, target table, or borrowed archive bytes ship

build_dag.name: full n600 joint debt and 25-row interface readout
build_dag.deliverable: same-object local frozen-scorer d_seg, d_pose, archive bytes, exact coupled score, per-class/per-pair debt, and all 25 IS1 SKELETON/FIBER outcomes
build_dag.gate: resumable batch16 stages, immutable launch manifest, end-of-run input barrier, exact aggregate closure, and coupled-score audit

build_dag.name: factor compiler and terminal quotient race
